title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: a vendor credit shows a dash for due date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has an unused vendor credit.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Unpaid Invoices" in the left list.
  3. Open vendor Y's group.
  4. Find the vendor credit.
  5. Read its Due Date.
  6. Read its Past Due.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • "—".

Step 6:

  • "—".

Why this matters: A credit is not due; a date there would mislead.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-payable/ApUnpaidInvoicesReport.vue:426-441; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApUnpaidInvoicesFetcher.php:214-215. V1 code, quoted: `row.dueDate ? formatDate(row.dueDate) : '—' ... row.pastDue !== null ? row.pastDue : '—'`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-153) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.
